title: Removable singular frontier: the cut-off argument for ∂T₁ = 0 (proof of Simon 7.5.11, corrected)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, n = m + 1 ≥ 1, T, T₁ ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M₁ ⊆ ℝ^P and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n (n-vectors, MultiVector) such that: (h1) ∂T = 0 in U; (h2) T₁(ω) = ∫_{M₁} ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^n for ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U); (h3) |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ ‖α‖ (operator norm) for H^n-a.e. x ∈ M₁ and all n-covectors α; (h4) every z ∈ M₁ has an open neighbourhood G and c ∈ ℝ with T₁(ω) = c·T(ω) whenever tsupport ω ⊆ G; (h5) for every compact K ⊆ U there is a compact Z with H^m(Z) = 0 (Mathlib μH[m]) and closure(M₁) ∩ K ⊆ M₁ ∪ Z; (h6) for every compact K ⊆ U there are C ∈ ℝ and r₁ > 0 with H^n(M₁ ∩ B_r(x)) ≤ C r^n for x ∈ K and 0 < r < r₁. Then ∂T₁ = 0 in U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M₁ : Set (Euclid P)) (T T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (m + 1)), IsOpen U → T.boundary = 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T₁ ω = ∫ x in M₁, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m + 1].restrict M₁), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ ‖α‖) → (∀ z ∈ M₁, ∃ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G ∧ z ∈ G ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ G → T₁ ω = c * T ω) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Z : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact Z ∧ μH[(m : ℝ)] Z = 0 ∧ closure M₁ ∩ K ⊆ M₁ ∪ Z) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C r₁ : ℝ, 0 < r₁ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < r₁ → μHE[m + 1] (M₁ ∩ ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ (m + 1))) → T₁.boundary = 0
